Your reign is forever greatest Lord of hosts

Who’s seated on the throne
With crown of grace and scepter of authority

And declare/proclaim Your sovereignty

We declare/proclaim!.

Your reign has no end

songs.title: THE LORD IS PRESENT HERE
songs.lyrics:
PRE-CHORUS
All:
You may be in so much pain
Alex:
Doctors have no answers
All:
Science said there's no cure for you
Alex:
Now, you are in despair
Desperate for a change
All:
We are here in truth
VERSE 1
Alex:
The Lord Jesus came down from the mountain
Followed by a large crowd
There then came a man with leprosy
Who knelt before Him, saying
"Lord, if you're willing
You can make me clean."
The Master replied him and said
"I am willing, be clean!"
And he was cleansed
CHORUS
The Lord is present here
The giver of eternal life
He’s reaching out through us
To make you whole again
Just believe
The Master is present here
With compassion, in love and grace
You'll never be the same
Just receive His word for you
VERSE 2
Faith:
A man named Jairus sought Jesus
He said
"My daughter is at death's door
If you can lay hands on her, she will live"
Word came from home saying
"Trouble the Master no more
Your daughter is dead"
But Jesus replied
All:
"Be not afraid, only believe"
Faith:
"She's not dead but only asleep
Stop the tears
Cry no more."
And with compassion in His voice
He said to the girl, "Arise."
All:
And immediately she arose and walked
CHORUS
The Lord is present here
The giver of eternal life
He’s reaching out through us
To make you whole again
Just believe
The Master is present here
With compassion, in love and grace
You'll never be the same
Just receive His word for you
REFRAIN
Soprano:
Only believe
He wants you whole
Tenor:
He loves you
Yes, he loves you
Alto:
Only believe
END
Soloists:
The master is here
With compassion and love
Just receive His word for you

songs.title: JESUS SAVES ZACCHAEUS
songs.lyrics:
VERSE 1
Soloists:
One day, a tax collector in the Bible named Zacchaeus
Climbed up the sycamore tree
To see the Master Jesus
As he was passing by with his disciples
Ogey:
Zacchaeus was a sinner and a known cheat in the land
Jesus saw him up the tree and called out to him
Soloists:
"Zacchaeus, come down quickly"
"I will abide at your house today"
He welcomed Jesus, with joyful excitement
He returned all he got from others by way of cheating them
He received mercy from God, he was forgiven
Ogey and Dcns. Megan:
Jesus brought salvation to him and his household
And they were saved
PRE-CHORUS
Dcns. Megan:
Though your sin be as scarlet
They shall be white as snow
Though they be as crimson
They shall be as wool
All:
Jesus came to seek and save the lost
He'll do the same for you today
CHORUS 1
All:
There is no depth nor height
That can separate you from his love
There is no sin nor wrong
That can stop his love for you
Your colour, state, or your stature
Cannot dim his love for you
What is impossible with men
Is possible with God
VERSE 2
Ogey:
One day, a young man who was paralyzed and bent over
Was brought to the Master Jesus at Capernaum, to be healed
When Jesus saw their faith
He said to the man, "Your sins are forgiven"
And he was healed
Soloists:
The people who saw this awesome miracle
Recognized that it was God who gave Jesus the power
Ogey:
To heal and forgive sins
They gave praise and glory to God
Who was at work in their midst
CHORUS 2
All:
Jesus is here right now, healing your body
Mending your bones, restoring your health
He's giving you life
His power is working in you now
You will be healed, fully restored
And made whole
You will be healed, fully restored
And made whole

songs.title: Only Jesus word is Yay and Amen
songs.lyrics:
​Verse 1
​Bro Treasure:
She walked in shadows, bent and bound,
Eighteen long years, no help was found.
A heavy burden, unseen chains,
A soul that yearned through constant pains.
But hope was near, though eyes were dim,
As love stepped in—and called to her.

​Verse 2
​Sis Aity:
She stood in the crowd, so weary and weak,
Her body was bent, but her faith didn't break.
Then Jesus saw her, with grace in His eyes,
He spoke with power, and the sickness disappeared.
He stretched His hand, His voice was clear:
"Daughter, be loose—your healing is here!"

​Pre-Chorus
​Bro Treasure & Sis Aity:
What Jesus did then, He is doing today,
His healing power has not changed.
So open your heart, receive it right now,
Keep your eyes on the Lord!

​Chorus
​Choir:
You will be healed, your strength will be renewed,
Prepare your heart for what He’s about to do.
No matter the lie that the enemy penned,
Only Jesus’ word is Yea and Amen!
Only His word is truth!

​Refrain
​Sis Aity: She walked away, with light in her eyes,
Bro Treasure: No longer bound, she stood upright!
Bro Treasure & Sis Aity: And every heart that hears this today,
Knows Jesus’ love still heals.

​Pre-Chorus
​Bro Treasure & Sis Aity:
What Jesus did then, He is doing today,
His healing power has not changed away.
So open your heart, receive it right now,
Keep your eyes on the Lord!

​Chorus
​Choir:
You will be healed, your strength will be renewed,
Prepare your heart for what He’s about to do.
No matter the lie that the enemy penned,
Only Jesus’ word is Yea and Amen!
Only His word is truth!

​Solo Tags & Outro
​Bro Treasure:
Understand the miracle, see what He did then!
Get ready, get ready, He will do it again!

​Sis Aity:
You’ve seen the wonderful miracle of the woman who was bent,
Now, position your soul for the power He sends!
​Bro Treasure: He is here—get ready for your healing now!
Sis Aity: Be prepared—open your heart right now!
Bro Treasure & Sis Aity: You will walk and be healed today!

​Choir:
Only Jesus’ word is Yea and Amen!
Only His word is truth!

songs.title: LIFE BEGINS IN CHRIST
songs.lyrics:

Korede:
Lost in distant thoughts
Confined to an ancient, reclining chair
Of palatial design
Just living in memories of the good old days
But who would have thought
That the years up there would sprout wings
And fly so fast
From the mountain views of life and hill tops
Down to the sandy valleys below
To rest on mud
Israel:
Your once agile and bouncy body frame
Now, bowed over with pain
And barely able to move
Viwe, Israel and Korede:
Your most valuable companions now
Are your treasured walking stick
To compensate for your once-long strides
And an old piece of towel
To keep the discomforting flies at bay
Chisom and Ejura:
You have become so weak and frail
With trembling hands and wobbling limbs
Too afraid of heights that once kept you afloat
All Soloists:
And sounds that once fuelled your excitement
Oh, the burning reality of the ironies of worldliness
Living life away from its owner
The mere thought of ageing
With a failing frame
Is your worst nightmare

The puzzling questions popping up
In your memory with every thought, are
All Soloists:
“Where have the good old days gone, suddenly?”
Ejura:
“How did life turn out this way for me??”
“Where is my life going”
Chisom:
“Can there be a change?”
“Can I find a solution?”
All Soloists:
The good news is
When you receive the ageless
Word of God in your heart
You’ll be changed
Into a new creation in Christ

You will gratefully and joyfully share
God’s blessings in your life with others

Your glorious life in Christ will begin today

songs.title: DADDY, SEE WHAT I CAN DO
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vanessa:
From the balcony 
A loving dad sighted his four-year-old daughter 
On a Saturday 
Crawling from the dining, through the staircase 
Struggling to make her way up, with obvious difficulty 
Dcn. Shine:
This was a troubling sight for her father 
Who was watching this strange scenario 
Her uncle echoed as he reached out to her 
"Get up from the floor and walk properly," he said 
She answered, "I can’t," and began to cry 
He raises her up, but she falls back to the floor
Not being able to walk 
Ejura: 
Her father, in disbelief 
Of what was happening to his girl
A child who had gone to school the previous day
Strong, healthy, and happy 
Was now unable to walk
What had gone wrong? 
She was taken to several doctors 
And they all confirmed she had a crippling disease 
And will never walk again  
Israel:
Her father, being a preacher
Knew that this was a strong test of faith 
He dared to believe in the word of God
Which he preached
He took up his shield of faith
With the word of God
Ready to quench the fiery darts of fear and doubt
Choir:
He erased the negative pictures
Of his crippled daughter from his mind
And replaced them
With positive pictures in line
With his positive, daily confessions 
"My little girl will walk again"
"She will run again"
"She will jump again"
"No stopping her"
Dcn. Shine:
In the face of this critical adversity
His faith in the powerful name of Jesus was unshakable 
Glory to the mighty name that works wonders
Vanessa:
Then, on one glorious day, at the car park 
His little daughter opened the car door  
And shouted, "Daddy, see what I can do"
She leapt out of the car
Stood on her two legs
And began running around in a circle 
Hallelujah 
Hallelujah 
Hallelujah 
Choir:
Her father cried out with so much joy 
And with gratitude to the Lord 
Saying, "Thank you, Lord Jesus"
"I knew you would do it!"
"I knew you would do it"
Blessed be your wonderful name that never fails
And by your word, we are ever victorious
Chorus
Blessed be the Lord who sits on the throne
Blessed be the Lord, Creator of all
You alone are God in all of the earth
Blessed be the Lord
Your word never fails
Your word is beautiful 
Most glorious is your name 
Wonderful are your ways 
Blessed be the Lord
My mouth sings your praise
Sings your praise
Verse 2
Viwe:
Are you in a similar situation 
Or challenged by situations 
That are seemingly overwhelming 
Jesus said, "If you abide in me, and my word abide in you"
"Ask what you will, and it shall be done unto you"
By faith in his word, you can change anything
Pst. Saki:
As we call upon the name of the Lord Jesus
Choir:
Jesus
Pst. Saki:
The works of darkness will be subdued in your life 
Crippling pains and diseases will be gone 
Receive your miracle 
For anything is possible in the name of Jesus 
You will leave here today, rejoicing 
Coda
Today is your day
Don't you give up
Your healing is here
All soloists:
Your healing is here

songs.title: Only Jesus word is Yay and Amen
songs.lyrics:
​Verse 1
​Bro Treasure:
She walked in shadows, bent and bound,
Eighteen long years, no help was found.
A heavy burden, unseen chains,
A soul that yearned through constant pains.
But hope was near, though eyes were dim,
As love stepped in—and called to her.

​Verse 2
​Sis Aity:
She stood in the crowd, so weary and weak,
Her body was bent, but her faith didn't break.
Then Jesus saw her, with grace in His eyes,
He spoke with power, and the sickness disappeared.
He stretched His hand, His voice was clear:
"Daughter, be loose—your healing is here!"

​Pre-Chorus
​Bro Treasure & Sis Aity:
What Jesus did then, He is doing today,
His healing power has not changed.
So open your heart, receive it right now,
Keep your eyes on the Lord!

​Chorus
​Choir:
You will be healed, your strength will be renewed,
Prepare your heart for what He’s about to do.
No matter the lie that the enemy penned,
Only Jesus’ word is Yea and Amen!
Only His word is truth!

​Refrain
​Sis Aity: She walked away, with light in her eyes,
Bro Treasure: No longer bound, she stood upright!
Bro Treasure & Sis Aity: And every heart that hears this today,
Knows Jesus’ love still heals.

​Pre-Chorus
​Bro Treasure & Sis Aity:
What Jesus did then, He is doing today,
His healing power has not changed away.
So open your heart, receive it right now,
Keep your eyes on the Lord!

​Chorus
​Choir:
You will be healed, your strength will be renewed,
Prepare your heart for what He’s about to do.
No matter the lie that the enemy penned,
Only Jesus’ word is Yea and Amen!
Only His word is truth!

​Solo Tags & Outro
​Bro Treasure:
Understand the miracle, see what He did then!
Get ready, get ready, He will do it again!

​Sis Aity:
You’ve seen the wonderful miracle of the woman who was bent,
Now, position your soul for the power He sends!
​Bro Treasure: He is here—get ready for your healing now!
Sis Aity: Be prepared—open your heart right now!
Bro Treasure & Sis Aity: You will walk and be healed today!

​Choir:
Only Jesus’ word is Yea and Amen!
Only His word is truth!

Solo:

In the atmosphere

Deep within my soul

The perfect place to be

Fear is dissolved
As we call on your mighty name
We are vitalised and refreshed
By your wonder working name
There is nothing your name can not do

Mighty to save and deliver
Those who call on you

songs.title: MY PRAYER FOR DAD
songs.lyrics:
You have spent precious

Moments, hours, days and nights

Fasting without food, praying for me

That I may be established in God’s

Perfect will and plans for me

You deprived yourself

of physical of leisures times without number

for my spiritual growth and benefits


While I slept

Your prayers watched over me

The groaning of your intercessory prayers

From your deepest soul

Kept hell at bay

Consumed by God’s Overwhelmed for me

You travailed in the spirit for me

as a shepherd Ordained of God and led by Christ

You care for me

You gave up everything just to take care of me

For the Master


Dad, my prayer for you
Is that, God keeps you
Vibrant and strong now and always
There shall be no end
To the increase of your
peace, greatness and victories
There shall be no end
Your hopes and dreams will be fulfilled
In glory By the hand of our God
You will see and enjoy
the beautiful fruits of your labor
Till the Lord returns
And your labor of love
for the Master rewarded
With a crown of glory with countless stars
Of souls you won for the kingdom
Amen amen amen

songs.title: ONLY JESUS WORD IS YEA AND AMEN
songs.lyrics:
​Verse 1 ​
Bro Treasure: 
She walked in shadows, bent and bound, 
Eighteen long years, no help was found. 
A heavy burden, unseen chains, 
A soul that yearned through constant pains. 
But hope was near, though eyes were dim, 
As love stepped in—and called to her. 

​Verse 2 ​
Sis Aity: 
She stood in the crowd, so weary and weak, 
Her body was bent, but her faith didn't break. 
Then Jesus saw her, with grace in His eyes, 
He spoke with power, and the sickness disappeared. 
He stretched His hand, His voice was clear: "Daughter, be loose—your healing is here!" ​

Pre-Chorus ​
Bro Treasure & Sis Aity: 
What Jesus did then, He is doing today, 
His healing power has not changed. 
So open your heart, receive it right now, 
Keep your eyes on the Lord! ​

Chorus ​
Choir: 
You will be healed, your strength will be renewed, Prepare your heart for what He’s about to do. 
No matter the lie that the enemy penned, 
Only Jesus’ word is Yea and Amen! 
Only His word is truth! ​

Refrain 
​Sis Aity: 
She walked away, with light in her eyes, 

Bro Treasure: 
No longer bound, she stood upright! 

Bro Treasure & Sis Aity:
And every heart that hears this today, 
Knows Jesus’ love still heals. ​

Pre-Chorus ​
Bro Treasure & Sis Aity: 
What Jesus did then, He is doing today, 
His healing power has not changed away. 
So open your heart, receive it right now, 
Keep your eyes on the Lord! ​

Chorus ​
Choir: 
You will be healed, your strength will be renewed, Prepare your heart for what He’s about to do. 
No matter the lie that the enemy penned, 
Only Jesus’ word is Yea and Amen! 
Only His word is truth! 

​Solo Tags & Outro ​Bro Treasure: 
Understand the miracle, see what He did then! 
Get ready, get ready, He will do it again! ​

Sis Aity: 
You’ve seen the wonderful miracle of the woman who was bent, 
Now, position your soul for the power He sends! ​

Bro Treasure: 
He is here—get ready for your healing now! 

Sis Aity: 
Be prepared—open your heart right now! 

Bro Treasure & Sis Aity: 
You will walk and be healed today! ​

Choir: 
Only Jesus’ word is Yea and Amen! 
Only His word is truth

songs.title: THAT SAME JESUS (HEARD - DUET)
songs.lyrics:
VERSE 1
Blessing:
Twelve years bound in silent pain
Her strength was gone, her hope was slain
Doctors’ hands had failed to mend
Her body weak, all her money spent

Ogey:
An outcast lone, unseen, unheard
Yet faith arose within her word
"If I but touch His robe today,
This plague of mine shall fade away."

Duet:
So she reached and touched His garment’s hem
And power flowed right into her
Her pain was gone, her heart made new
She knew His love had carried her through

CHORUS
That same Jesus is here for you
With grace to make you well
Only believe in His mighty name
And the words we say
That same power that conquered the grave
Will overwhelm and quicken your body
You'll be delivered and made whole today
In the matchless name of Jesus

You'll be free

VERSE 2
Blessing:
Thirty-eight years, he lay in wait
By waters stirred by the angel
Yet every time he sought to rise
Another stepped before his eyes

Ogey:
Then Jesus came and saw him there
A withered man in deep despair
“Rise, take your bed, walk forth today,”
And his weakness fled away

Duet:
New strength restored, he stood upright
His mourning turned to joy and light
The Healer spoke, His word was true
He knew His love had carried him through

CHORUS
That same Jesus is here for you
With grace to make you well
Only believe in His mighty name
And the words we say
That same power that conquered the grave
Will overwhelm and quicken your body
You'll be delivered and made whole today
In the matchless name of Jesus

You'll be free

That you have taught me

To speak and sing of His glory and in power


My journey with you Dad

Has been the best days of my life

Happy birthday to my Dad

As love stepped in—and called to her.

She walked away, with light in her eyes,

What Jesus did then, He is doing today,

You will be healed, your strength will be renewed, Prepare your heart for what He’s about to do.

Choir:

It always fulfills Your will

No power can stop it still

*- "Inseparably made one with you" was changed to "Made inseparably one with you."*

Hold on. I thought something was wrong with that construction.
"Inseparably made one with you" is not the same thing as "Made inseparably one with you.
Is it the whole choir that's singing it?

Now, this song requires quite some work.
I'm scoring the lyrics 5, and I'll tell you why.
I'm scoring the melody 4.5. I actually scored it 4, but at the end, when they were raising their voices nicely, I added 0.5.

The song is a really simple one, with very little being said. Very general truth. Very simplistic. It's like, you know, staying safe. The lyrics are long enough to have been bold, but they're not bold. They're being safe.

Now, it could be very simple while having the melody to back it. But in this case, it's very simple, with no melody. So it's not striking. Not in this context, no. In its melody. It's very average. And to bring the two of you out to sing an average song? No! Not acceptable!

So, either reconstruct the music, with more work on the lyrics and melody. It's got to be far better.

Thank you!

*Monday, 13th July 2026*

*THE INSTRUCTION*
*- Lead singer to work on her voice intensely, from now till the end of August.*

*THE INSTRUCTION THAT LED TO THE DIALOGUE*
Now, the problem with this one is voice stability. What are you going to do about it?
I told you to do a program some time ago, did you do it?

*Dcns. Rose:* Yes, Pastor Sir. I'm still on it.

*The President:* What happened? That program is not supposed to take more than 2 months. How come she's not done?
She says sometimes you are not available.

He (Dcn Isaiah) says sometimes they are not really available. That is, those of them who are supposed to be doing that class.

Let me explain. Anybody's voice can be changed. You have to know that. The human voice is very, very malleable. You can make your voice change completely, in such a way that it's different from how it sounded originally. You can make your voice sound better, whether in speech or in songs.
So, when you want to sing better, and you should want to sing better, you work on your voice. And working on your voice is not about the range. Sometimes, it's the quality of the voice itself. The texture of the voice itself. And then also, where you sing from, whether you're singing from the top of your voice or the bottom. All that matters.
You haven't done what I told you to do, and it's affecting the quality of your singing.

Do the first verse.

So, I want to give you a chance to work on your voice, because you can. If you are serious with it, you can.
There are 3 of you that have not taken it seriously to work on your voices.
1. Yourself.
2. Jebbaj. Jebbaj is a good singer, but she's not ready to do the hard work that it requires. And it's not hard. It's just a choice.
3. The third person is J.Jude. You notice I hardly like to feature her in any song with the choir. I don't mind to feature her when she's singing alone, because at that point, you bear the responsibility for however it goes. But she loves to sing, and she can sing. When she does the solos, nobody can tell her it's wrong because she's the only one singing it, and she can sing it any which way she wants to go. But when you're doing it with the choir, you have to do it according to the arrangement of the choir. It's a deal that this is how you're going to sing it, and this is how they are going to sing it with you. And the voice must be stable.

So, you have to work hard to make your singing a far greater experience. Truth is, you can. It won't take you long. Envision it. Say, "I want to change the way I sing," and it's going to get better. Once you give yourself to it, you'll see the difference. Even you will know.
Several of you are singing far better than they used to. And it's not because they feature in the songs, but because they work hard. They sing outside here, that means outside the rehearsals. They're working hard on themselves, trying to sing better all the time. Some overdo it, overwork and sing more than they should. I have a couple of them.

So, give it a shot. Right?
I'm going to give you between now and the end of August. That's like 6 weeks. Let's see what you do to yourself. Intense work. Intense training. I guarantee you, if you do it, you will be amazed. But you'll be proud of yourself. You'll be glad you did.

Thank you!
